#==========================
# Section 1. Mapping workflow:
#==========================

```{Linux Phoenix HPC}
1.  Shiraz + PN T2T + Rug meta-Genome

cat *.fasta > Shiraz_PN_RUG_metagenome.fasta
cat T2T*.fasta > Vvinifera_T2Tv5_combined.fasta
cat *_140Ruggeri.fasta> Rug_cat_meta.fasta
cat SHZ_1654_*.fasta> SHZ_cat_meta.fasta

2.  Trimming
AdapterRemoval \
    --file1 "$R1_FILE" \
    --file2 "$R2_FILE" \
    --basename "$OUTPUT_BASENAME" \
    --minlength 100 \
    --trimns \
    --trimqualities \
    --gzip \
    --output1 "${OUTPUT_BASENAME}.R1.trimmed.fq.gz" \
    --output2 "${OUTPUT_BASENAME}.R2.trimmed.fq.gz" \
    --singleton "${OUTPUT_BASENAME}.singleton.trimmed.fq.gz"

3.  Default alignment + allbestscore
STAR --runMode genomeGenerate \
--runThreadN 8 \
--genomeDir "$GENOME_INDEX_DIR" \
--genomeFastaFiles "Shiraz_PN_RUG_metagenome.fasta" \
--genomeSAindexNbases 14

STAR --genomeDir "$GENOME_INDEX_DIR" \
--runThreadN "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" \
--readFilesIn "$R1_FILE" "$R2_FILE" \
--readFilesCommand zcat \
--alignIntronMax 50000 \
--alignMatesGapMax 10000 \
--outFileNamePrefix "${ALIGNMENT_DIR}/${sample_name}_" \
--outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate \
--outSAMprimaryFlag AllBestScore \
--outFilterType BySJout \
--alignIntronMin 20 \
--alignSJoverhangMin 8 \
--alignSJDBoverhangMin 1 \
--sjdbScore 1
samtools view -b -@ 8 -F 260 -o "$OUTPUT_BAM" "$INPUT_BAM"

4.  Filter out primary alignment in both genotypes
samtools view -L "$VITIS_BED" "$INPUT_BAM" | cut -f1 | sort | uniq > "${TEMP_DIR}/vitis_reads.txt" || { echo "Error: Failed to create Vitis reads list." >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Finding reads that align to Ruggeri chromosomes..."

samtools view -L "$RUGGERI_BED" "$INPUT_BAM" | cut -f1 | sort | uniq > "${TEMP_DIR}/ruggeri_reads.txt" || { echo "Error: Failed to create Ruggeri reads list." >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Finding the intersection of reads that align to BOTH genomes..."

comm -12 "${TEMP_DIR}/vitis_reads.txt" "${TEMP_DIR}/ruggeri_reads.txt" > "${TEMP_DIR}/both_alignments_reads.txt" || { echo "Error: Failed to find intersection." >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Filtering out reads that align to BOTH genomes from the input BAM..."

samtools view -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" -b -o /dev/null -U "$OUTPUT_BAM" -N "${TEMP_DIR}/both_alignments_reads.txt" "$INPUT_BAM"

# Separate Bam file into SHZ and RUG genome. No read mapped to PN T2T genome used in downstream, we utilize PN T2T as a filler and netting out the reads mapped to the assembly gaps to SHZ and RUG genomes. We do not know which these reads from, so we should discard them. 
# The -L flag explicitly grabs only the contigs in the Shiraz BED. PN and Ruggeri are dropped.
samtools view -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" -b -L "$SHZ_BED_FILE" "$CURRENT_BAM" > "$OUTPUT_SHZ"

# The -L flag explicitly grabs only the contigs in the Ruggeri BED. PN and Shiraz are dropped.
samtools view -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" -b -L "$RUG_BED_FILE" "$CURRENT_BAM" > "$OUTPUT_RUG"
```
5.  Filter out genome positions that covered by all Self-grafted samples
```{Linux}
# Create Shiraz self-graft blacklist
#B = Bud, L = Leaf, PY = Phloem, R = Root
TISSUES=("B" "L" "PY" "R")

for TISSUE in "${TISSUES[@]}"; do
    
    echo "Processing Tissue Group: SS${TISSUE}"
    
    # Dynamically grab the 4 replicates for the current tissue
    TISSUE_BAMS="${BAM_DIR}/SS${TISSUE}1_PrimaryMapped.bam ${BAM_DIR}/SS${TISSUE}2_PrimaryMapped.bam ${BAM_DIR}/SS${TISSUE}3_PrimaryMapped.bam ${BAM_DIR}/SS${TISSUE}4_PrimaryMapped.bam"
    
    # Define the specific output file for this tissue
    OUTPUT_BED="${OUTPUT_DIR}/Final_SS_${TISSUE}_Background_Blacklist.bed"
    echo "Calculating absolute genome coverage intervals for SS${TISSUE}..."
    
    # The GENOMECOV pipeline: Mathematically calculates coverage, ignoring CIGAR complexity.
    samtools merge -u -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" - $TISSUE_BAMS | \
    bedtools genomecov -ibam stdin -bga -split | \
    awk '$4>0 {print $1"\t"$2"\t"$3}' | \
    bedtools merge -i - > "$OUTPUT_BED"    
    echo "Blacklist successfully created at: $OUTPUT_BED"
    echo "--------------------------------------------------------"
done
echo "All tissue-specific blacklists generated successfully!"

# Filter out SR same genome position covered by Shiraz self-graft bedtools position

bedtools intersect -v -split -a "$CURRENT_BAM" -b "$BLACKLIST" | \
samtools sort -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" -o "$CLEAN_BAM"
samtools index -@ "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" "$CLEAN_BAM"

6.  Count exon expression: 1 reads per gene
featureCounts \
  -T "$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" \
  -p \
  -M \
  --fraction \
  -t exon \
  -g gene_id \
  -a "$ANNOTATION_GTF" \
  -o "$OUTPUT_MATRIX" \
  "$BAM_DIR"/*_Cleaned.bam

7.  In primary alignment, count TPM of mobile genes > 1 in R
```

```{r}
  arrange(gene.chr, gene.end)

# T2T

T2T_gene <- T2T_gene.info.from.gff %>%
  filter(type == "gene") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., paste, collapse = ","))) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.) | as.character(.) == "" | as.character(.) == "character(0)"))) %>%

    gene.id = str_remove(gene.id, "^(gene:|CDS:|transcript:)"),

  filter(!str_starts(X1, "f?#")) %>%
  separate(
    col = X1,
    into = c("gene.chr", "source", "gene.biotype", "gene.start", "gene.end", "score", "gene.strand", "phase", "gene.id"),
    sep = "\t",
```

# Cleanup annotation
```{r}
# Make sure the annotation is one gene on one contig
Rug_gene_gff <- Rug_gene.info.from.gff %>%
  filter(gene.biotype == "gene") %>%
  arrange(gene.chr, gene.end)

# Assuming your gene identifier column is named 'gene.id'
# (Change 'gene.id' to your actual column name if it's different)

problem_genes <- Rug_gene_gff %>%
  # Group by the unique gene identifier
  group_by(gene.id) %>%
  
  # Summarize to count the number of UNIQUE chromosomes/contigs for that gene
  summarize(
    unique_contig_count = n_distinct(gene.chr),
    contigs_listed = paste(unique(gene.chr), collapse = ", ") # Optional: lists the specific contigs
  ) %>%
  
  # Filter to only show genes that map to more than 1 contig
  filter(unique_contig_count > 1)

# Check the results
if(nrow(problem_genes) == 0) {
  print("Success: All genes map to exactly one contig.")
} else {
  print(paste("Warning: Found", nrow(problem_genes), "genes mapping to multiple contigs."))
  print(problem_genes)
}
```

### filter mobile RNA read in each repeat group

```{r}
# Update the default parameter to 0.01 so you never accidentally filter out fractions!
filter_by_reps <- function(df, min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 4) {
  df %>%
    filter(rowSums(dplyr::select(., 7:ncol(.)) >= min_count) >= min_reps)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EXAMPLE 1: Keep genes with >0 count in ALL 4 reps
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Mob_SR_bud_4reps  <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_bud_to_Rug_raw_counts,  min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 4)
Mob_SR_leaf_4reps <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_leaf_to_Rug_raw_counts, min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 4)
Mob_SR_PY_4reps   <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_PY_to_Rug_raw_counts,   min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 4)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EXAMPLE 2: Keep genes with >0 count in ANY 3 rep 
# (This is the one you feed into your 50% coverage script!)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Mob_SR_bud_3reps  <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_bud_to_Rug_raw_counts,  min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 3)
Mob_SR_leaf_3reps <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_leaf_to_Rug_raw_counts, min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 3)
Mob_SR_PY_3reps   <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_PY_to_Rug_raw_counts,   min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 3)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EXAMPLE 3: Keep genes with >0 count in ANY 1 rep 
# (This is the one you feed into your 50% coverage script!)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Mob_SR_bud_2reps  <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_bud_to_Rug_raw_counts,  min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 2)
Mob_SR_leaf_2reps <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_leaf_to_Rug_raw_counts, min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 2)
Mob_SR_PY_2reps   <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_PY_to_Rug_raw_counts,   min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# EXAMPLE 4: Keep genes with >0 count in ANY 1 rep 
# (This is the one you feed into your 50% coverage script!)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
Mob_SR_bud_1reps  <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_bud_to_Rug_raw_counts,  min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 1)
Mob_SR_leaf_1reps <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_leaf_to_Rug_raw_counts, min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 1)
Mob_SR_PY_1reps   <- filter_by_reps(Mob_SR_PY_to_Rug_raw_counts,   min_count = 0.01, min_reps = 1)
```

### Define function for transcript coverage

```{r}
# Define the function
calculate_mobile_coverage <- function(tissue_exon_gff, bam_directory, threshold = 0.70) {
  
  message("\n--- Starting analysis for directory: ", bam_directory, " ---")
  
  # 1. CLEAN THE EXONS & BUILD THE GRANGES OBJECT
  mobile_exon_clean <- tissue_exon_gff %>%
    distinct(gene.chr, gene.start, gene.end, gene.strand, gene.id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  GRange_exons <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    mobile_exon_clean,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "gene.chr",
    start.field = "gene.start",
    end.field = "gene.end",
    strand.field = "gene.strand",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2. APPLY THE BAM HEADER FIX
  bamfiles <- list.files(bam_directory, pattern=".bam$", full.names = TRUE)
  if(length(bamfiles) == 0) stop("No BAM files found in this directory!")
  
  bam_header <- scanBamHeader(bamfiles[1])
  true_bam_lengths <- bam_header[[1]]$targets
  
  common_chrs <- intersect(seqlevels(GRange_exons), names(true_bam_lengths))
  seqlevels(GRange_exons, pruning.mode="coarse") <- common_chrs
  seqlengths(GRange_exons) <- true_bam_lengths[common_chrs]
  
  # 3. LOOP THROUGH REPLICATES TO CALCULATE COVERAGE
  coverage_results_list <- lapply(bamfiles, function(bamfile) {
    sample_name <- basename(bamfile)
    message("  -> Processing: ", sample_name)
    
    bam.input <- readGAlignments(bamfile, param = ScanBamParam(which = GRange_exons))
    bam_coverage <- coverage(bam.input)
    exon_specific_coverage <- bam_coverage[GRange_exons]
    
    exon_results <- as.data.frame(GRange_exons) %>%
      mutate(
        covered_bases = sum(exon_specific_coverage > 0),
        exon_length = width
      )
    
    transcript_coverage <- exon_results %>%
      group_by(gene.id) %>%
      summarise(
        total_covered_bases = sum(covered_bases),
        total_transcript_length = sum(exon_length),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        percent_coverage = total_covered_bases / total_transcript_length,
        sample_id = sample_name
      )
    
    rm(bam.input, bam_coverage, exon_specific_coverage)
    gc()
    
    return(transcript_coverage)
  })
  
  # 4. COMBINE AND FILTER THE FINAL RESULTS
  all_coverage <- bind_rows(coverage_results_list)
  
  confident_mobile_genes <- all_coverage %>%
    filter(percent_coverage >= threshold)
  
  message("--- Finished! Found ", nrow(confident_mobile_genes), " confident events. ---\n")
  return(confident_mobile_genes)
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================

SRB_coverage_wide <- Mobile_RNAs_coverage_length_SRB %>%
  dplyr::select(gene.id, sample_id, percent_coverage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = percent_coverage)

# Step B: Merge with counts and format the text

  left_join(SRB_coverage_wide, by = "gene.id") %>%
  # Target only the BAM columns, replace NA with "< 0.7", and leave actual numbers alone
  mutate(across(ends_with(".bam"), 
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "< 0.7", as.character(round(., 7))))) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene.id, SRB1, SRB2, SRB3, SRB4, SRB1_PrimaryMapped.bam, SRB2_PrimaryMapped.bam, SRB3_PrimaryMapped.bam, SRB4_PrimaryMapped.bam)

  left_join(SRL_coverage_wide, by = "gene.id") %>%

# ==========================================================

  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = percent_coverage)

SRPY_Final_Table <- Mob_SR_PY_1reps %>%
  left_join(SRPY_coverage_wide, by = "gene.id") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with(".bam"), 
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "< 0.7", as.character(round(., 7))))) %>%
```

### Mobile RNA as 1. clean reads > 0.01 (as featureCount splice multi-mapper). 2. Length >70%

```{r}

    Pass_Rep2 = (SRB2 >= 0.01) & (SRB2_PrimaryMapped.bam != "< 0.7"),
    
    # Rep 3 must have > 0.01 counts AND not have failed coverage
```

### extract mobile transcripts exon infor

```{r}
SHZ_gene.info.from.gff <- read_lines("F:/PhD_Research/2nd_Chapter_Mobile_RNA/Reference_genomes/Annotations/Final_annotations/SHZ_1654_combined_annotation.gff3") %>%
  tibble(raw_text = .) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^#", raw_text)) %>%
  separate(raw_text, 
           into = c("X1", "X2", "X3", "X4", "X5", "X6", "X7", "X8", "X9"), 
           sep = "\\s+",      # Regex for "any whitespace"
           extra = "merge",   # Stops splitting after the 9th column!
           fill = "right") %>%
  # Now your original select will work perfectly
  dplyr::select(X1, X4, X5, X9, X7, X3) %>%
  set_colnames(c("gene.chr", "gene.start", "gene.end", "gene.id", "gene.strand", "gene.biotype")) %>%
  mutate(across(2:3, as.numeric)) %>%
  arrange(gene.chr, gene.start) %>%
  na.omit()

SHZ_exon_gff <- SHZ_gene.info.from.gff %>%
  filter(gene.biotype == "exon") %>%
  mutate(
    gene.id = str_extract(gene.id, "(?<=Parent=)[^;]+"),
    gene.id = str_remove(gene.id, "-T\\d+$")
  ) %>%
  arrange(gene.chr, gene.end)

SRR_mobile_exon_gff <- SHZ_exon_gff %>% filter(gene.id %in% Mob_SR_root_1reps$gene.id)  
```

### Define function for transcript coverage

```{r}
# Define the function
calculate_mobile_coverage <- function(tissue_exon_gff, bam_directory, threshold = 0.70) {
  
  message("\n--- Starting analysis for directory: ", bam_directory, " ---")
  
  # 1. CLEAN THE EXONS & BUILD THE GRANGES OBJECT
  mobile_exon_clean <- tissue_exon_gff %>%
    distinct(gene.chr, gene.start, gene.end, gene.strand, gene.id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  GRange_exons <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    mobile_exon_clean,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "gene.chr",
    start.field = "gene.start",
    end.field = "gene.end",
    strand.field = "gene.strand",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2. APPLY THE BAM HEADER FIX
  bamfiles <- list.files(bam_directory, pattern=".bam$", full.names = TRUE)
  if(length(bamfiles) == 0) stop("No BAM files found in this directory!")
  
  bam_header <- scanBamHeader(bamfiles[1])
  true_bam_lengths <- bam_header[[1]]$targets
  
  common_chrs <- intersect(seqlevels(GRange_exons), names(true_bam_lengths))
  seqlevels(GRange_exons, pruning.mode="coarse") <- common_chrs
  seqlengths(GRange_exons) <- true_bam_lengths[common_chrs]
  
  # 3. LOOP THROUGH REPLICATES TO CALCULATE COVERAGE
  coverage_results_list <- lapply(bamfiles, function(bamfile) {
    sample_name <- basename(bamfile)
    message("  -> Processing: ", sample_name)
    
    bam.input <- readGAlignments(bamfile, param = ScanBamParam(which = GRange_exons))
    bam_coverage <- coverage(bam.input)
    exon_specific_coverage <- bam_coverage[GRange_exons]
    
    exon_results <- as.data.frame(GRange_exons) %>%
      mutate(
        covered_bases = sum(exon_specific_coverage > 0),
        exon_length = width
      )
    
    transcript_coverage <- exon_results %>%
      group_by(gene.id) %>%
      summarise(
        total_covered_bases = sum(covered_bases),
        total_transcript_length = sum(exon_length),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        percent_coverage = total_covered_bases / total_transcript_length,
        sample_id = sample_name
      )
    
    rm(bam.input, bam_coverage, exon_specific_coverage)
    gc()
    
    return(transcript_coverage)
  })
  
  # 4. COMBINE AND FILTER THE FINAL RESULTS
  all_coverage <- bind_rows(coverage_results_list)
  
  confident_mobile_genes <- all_coverage %>%
    filter(percent_coverage >= threshold)
  
  message("--- Finished! Found ", nrow(confident_mobile_genes), " confident events. ---\n")
  return(confident_mobile_genes)
}
```

### Define function for transcript coverage

```{r}
# Define the function
calculate_mobile_coverage <- function(tissue_exon_gff, bam_directory, threshold = 0.7) {
  
  message("\n--- Starting analysis for directory: ", bam_directory, " ---")
  
  # 1. CLEAN THE EXONS & BUILD THE GRANGES OBJECT
  mobile_exon_clean <- tissue_exon_gff %>%
    distinct(gene.chr, gene.start, gene.end, gene.strand, gene.id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  GRange_exons <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    mobile_exon_clean,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "gene.chr",
    start.field = "gene.start",
    end.field = "gene.end",
    strand.field = "gene.strand",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2. APPLY THE BAM HEADER FIX
  bamfiles <- list.files(bam_directory, pattern=".bam$", full.names = TRUE)
  if(length(bamfiles) == 0) stop("No BAM files found in this directory!")
  
  bam_header <- scanBamHeader(bamfiles[1])
  true_bam_lengths <- bam_header[[1]]$targets
  
  common_chrs <- intersect(seqlevels(GRange_exons), names(true_bam_lengths))
  seqlevels(GRange_exons, pruning.mode="coarse") <- common_chrs
  seqlengths(GRange_exons) <- true_bam_lengths[common_chrs]
  
  # 3. LOOP THROUGH REPLICATES TO CALCULATE COVERAGE
  coverage_results_list <- lapply(bamfiles, function(bamfile) {
    sample_name <- basename(bamfile)
    message("  -> Processing: ", sample_name)
    
    bam.input <- readGAlignments(bamfile, param = ScanBamParam(which = GRange_exons))
    bam_coverage <- coverage(bam.input)
    exon_specific_coverage <- bam_coverage[GRange_exons]
    
    exon_results <- as.data.frame(GRange_exons) %>%
      mutate(
        covered_bases = sum(exon_specific_coverage > 0),
        exon_length = width
      )
    
    transcript_coverage <- exon_results %>%
      group_by(gene.id) %>%
      summarise(
        total_covered_bases = sum(covered_bases),
        total_transcript_length = sum(exon_length),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        percent_coverage = total_covered_bases / total_transcript_length,
        sample_id = sample_name
      )
    
    rm(bam.input, bam_coverage, exon_specific_coverage)
    gc()
    
    return(transcript_coverage)
  })
  
  # 4. COMBINE AND FILTER THE FINAL RESULTS
  all_coverage <- bind_rows(coverage_results_list)
  
  confident_mobile_genes <- all_coverage %>%
    filter(percent_coverage >= threshold)
  
  message("--- Finished! Found ", nrow(confident_mobile_genes), " confident events. ---\n")
  return(confident_mobile_genes)
}
```

### Define function for transcript coverage

```{r}
# Define the function
calculate_mobile_coverage <- function(tissue_exon_gff, bam_directory, threshold = 0.70) {
  
  message("\n--- Starting analysis for directory: ", bam_directory, " ---")
  
  # 1. CLEAN THE EXONS & BUILD THE GRANGES OBJECT
  mobile_exon_clean <- tissue_exon_gff %>%
    distinct(gene.chr, gene.start, gene.end, gene.strand, gene.id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  GRange_exons <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    mobile_exon_clean,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "gene.chr",
    start.field = "gene.start",
    end.field = "gene.end",
    strand.field = "gene.strand",
    starts.in.df.are.0based = FALSE
  )
  
  # 2. APPLY THE BAM HEADER FIX
  bamfiles <- list.files(bam_directory, pattern=".bam$", full.names = TRUE)
  if(length(bamfiles) == 0) stop("No BAM files found in this directory!")
  
  bam_header <- scanBamHeader(bamfiles[1])
  true_bam_lengths <- bam_header[[1]]$targets
  
  common_chrs <- intersect(seqlevels(GRange_exons), names(true_bam_lengths))
  seqlevels(GRange_exons, pruning.mode="coarse") <- common_chrs
  seqlengths(GRange_exons) <- true_bam_lengths[common_chrs]
  
  # 3. LOOP THROUGH REPLICATES TO CALCULATE COVERAGE
  coverage_results_list <- lapply(bamfiles, function(bamfile) {
    sample_name <- basename(bamfile)
    message("  -> Processing: ", sample_name)
    
    bam.input <- readGAlignments(bamfile, param = ScanBamParam(which = GRange_exons))
    bam_coverage <- coverage(bam.input)
    exon_specific_coverage <- bam_coverage[GRange_exons]
    
    exon_results <- as.data.frame(GRange_exons) %>%
      mutate(
        covered_bases = sum(exon_specific_coverage > 0),
        exon_length = width
      )
    
    transcript_coverage <- exon_results %>%
      group_by(gene.id) %>%
      summarise(
        total_covered_bases = sum(covered_bases),
        total_transcript_length = sum(exon_length),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        percent_coverage = total_covered_bases / total_transcript_length,
        sample_id = sample_name
      )
    
    rm(bam.input, bam_coverage, exon_specific_coverage)
    gc()
    
    return(transcript_coverage)
  })
  
  # 4. COMBINE AND FILTER THE FINAL RESULTS
  all_coverage <- bind_rows(coverage_results_list)
  
  confident_mobile_genes <- all_coverage %>%
    filter(percent_coverage >= threshold)
  
  message("--- Finished! Found ", nrow(confident_mobile_genes), " confident events. ---\n")
  return(confident_mobile_genes)
}
```

```{r}
  `2rep (>= 2 Reps)` = c(
    nrow(df2_RSR_2reps)),
   `High Confidence (>= 3 Reps)` = c(
    nrow(df3_RSR_3reps)),
  `Gold Standard (All 4 Reps)` = c(
    nrow(df4_RSR_4reps)))

print(RS_Root_mobile_summary)
```

### Save the number of mobile genes

```{r}
write_csv(RS_Root_mobile_summary, "RS_Root_mobile_summary.csv")
```
